description: This file defines a SwiftUI view called SettingsRefreshButton which displays either a ProgressView when loading or a 'Refresh' button when not loading. It encapsulates a refresh button UI component with loading state handling.

classes.name: SettingsRefreshButton
classes.description: A SwiftUI View representing a refresh button that shows a loading indicator when 'isLoading' is true.

methods.name: body
methods.description: The computed property that defines the view's content, displaying either a ProgressView or a Button depending on the loading state.
